resources.name: How to Build Android Apps with Kotlin
resources.desc: This book starts with the fundamentals of app development. Moving ahead, you'll get to grips with testing, learn how to keep your architecture clean, understand how to persist data, and gain basic knowledge of the dependency injection pattern. Finally, you'll see how to publish your apps on the Google Play store.

resources.name: Instant Android Fragmentation Management How-to
resources.desc: Instant Android Fragmentation Management How-to is a step-by-step guide to writing applications that can run on all devices starting from Android 1.6.

resources.name: Instant Android Systems Development How-to
resources.desc: Instant Android Systems Development How-to provides a gentle introduction to the platform internals without sacrificing depth.

resources.name: Android Things Quick Start Guide

resources.name: 33 Engineering Challenges of Building Mobile Apps at Scale eBook & Other Learnings

resources.name: Android High Performance Programming

resources.name: Android Internals: A Confectioner's Cookbook

resources.name: Android Apprentice
resources.desc: Android Apprentice is the book for complete beginners to Android development.

resources.name: Reactive Programming with Kotlin
resources.desc: The book that teaches you to use RxJava, RxAndroid and RxKotlin to create complex reactive applications on Android and exercise full control over the library to leverage the full power of reactive programming in your apps.

resources.name: Android Test-Driven Development by Tutorials
resources.desc: A book that teaches you to write sustainable, testable apps, as well as to apply testing strategies to legacy projects via Espresso and UI tests, code coverage and refactoring.

resources.name: Advanced Android App Architecture
resources.desc: In Advanced Android App Architectures, you'll find a diverse and hands-on approach to architecting your apps on Android. Learn how to build scaleable and maintainable architectures in Android and Kotlin, including MVC, MVP, MVI, MVVM and VIPER!

resources.name: Data Structures & Algorithms in Kotlin
resources.desc: A book that teaches you the fundamental tools of implementing key data structures in Kotlin, and how to use them to solve algorithms.

resources.name: Kotlin for Android App Development

resources.name: Elements of Android Jetpack
resources.desc: This book follows in the footsteps of The Busy Coder's Guide to Android Development, to introduce developers to Android app development, focusing on Jetpack. Here you will learn how to set up an Android app for Java or Kotlin, create a user interface, and more!

resources.name: Exploring Android
resources.desc: This book has you build an app from the beginning. Whereas traditional programming guides are focused on breadth and depth, this book is focused on “hands-on”, guiding you through the steps to build the app.

resources.name: Elements of Android R
resources.desc: Each new release brings new opportunities and new challenges for Android developers. Many of the new challenges are extensions of the problems introduced in last year's Android 10. So, if you are worried about further changes to storage or permissions, or you are nervous about new restrictions being placed on developers, this book is for you!

resources.name: Elements of Android Room
resources.desc: This book explores Room.

resources.name: Elements of Android Q
resources.desc: As usual, Android 10 changed some things that affect developers and apps. This book profiles those changes and helps point out what you need to do to adjust your app to cope with those changes. So, if you are worried about the death of external storage and other things that Android 10 brings with it, this book is for you!

resources.name: Learning RxJava

resources.name: Gradle Recipes for Android
